test_policy.notes: Fayette freshmen: ACT/SAT submission is optional for applicants with a cumulative high school GPA of 2.4 or higher on a 4.0 scale; below 2.4, ACT or SAT scores must be submitted. International applicants are asked for official secondary transcripts; the international page does not mention an SAT/ACT requirement (SAT/ACT sub-scores are only one way to show English proficiency).

requirements.notes: UIU's own online application, free (about 15 minutes). International freshman steps: official secondary transcripts in English (or evaluated by WES, ECE or SpanTran; WAEC/WASSCE students may give scratch-card details), proof of English proficiency, passport copy, official bank statement showing funds for one full year (sent by the bank, no older than 6 months; affidavit of support if sponsored) and the non-refundable deposit (International Student Deposit $250 on the 2026-27 costs page). Fayette says it decides within two business days of a complete file. UIU may request additional documents or an interview.

deadlines.label: Rolling admission (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: No admission deadline for international students; UIU advises applying at least two months ahead to get a visa in time. The Fayette campus uses semesters, but the international page also says courses start every 8 weeks.

deadlines.label: Enrollment deposit refund cutoff
deadlines.notes: Fayette page: the $100 enrollment deposit is refundable through May 1 of the application year (December 31 for second-semester applicants). The international student deposit is a separate non-refundable $250.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived for students transferring from a US institution or educated in one of UIU's listed waiver countries (PDF list on the page). Test scores must be within the last two calendar years. Also accepted: MELAB 69, MUET 4.0, Cambridge O Level English D, IGCSE English D, HKCEE English (Syllabus B) D, HKALE English (AS) E, HKDSE 3, ELS 112, Oxford Online Placement Test 70, SAT critical reading sub-score 430 (institution code 6885), ACT English 18 (code 1360), TOEFL paper 500. Conditional admission: a student who meets all other requirements can be admitted if they complete UIU's Intensive English program (at least one semester level; no testing out) before academic classes.

english.notes: Internet-based 61 or higher (paper-based 500). Institution code 6885. No minimum on the new 1-6 scale is printed.
Overall band 5.0 and writing band 5.0 or higher.

aid.notes: International scholarships are automatic at admission, based on high school GPA, no separate application: Trustee (3.50-4.00) $4,000 per year, Presidential (3.00-3.49) $2,500, Dean's (2.50-2.99) $1,000, Achievement (2.00-2.49) $500. Transfer awards $500-$1,500 per year (a $5,500 Fayette transfer award needs 48 transferable credits). International students who get an athletic scholarship are not eligible. No international need-based aid was found; FAFSA aid is for US citizens and eligible non-citizens.

cost.notes: Fayette campus, full-time 12-18 credits: tuition $9,590 per semester ($19,180 per year), student fees $637.50 per semester ($1,275). One-time International Student Orientation $250 (shown as extra fees). Room and board shown is a sum of published items, not a published total: Garbee Hall double room $4,034 per year plus Peacock Blue unlimited meal plan $5,840 per year (undergraduates living on campus must have a meal plan; the cheaper Peacock Basic plan is only for Lee Tower and Hofmaster residents). Other rooms run $4,766-$7,944 per year. Books are not priced. No separate international tuition rate is published. Heading on the costs page: 2026-27 tuition and fees.
